# Test fixtures

`common-types.schema.json` is a snapshot copy of the A2UI v0.9.1 specification's
`common_types.json` (source: the `specification/v0_9_1` tree of
github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui, a2ui.org), vendored for offline `$ref` resolution
in the catalog tests. Only whitespace is normalized (prettier); `$defs` are
verbatim.
